items.label: Music From Memory
items.genre: Electroacoustic ambient, drone, transformed acoustic sound
items.context: Spanish composer Suso Sáiz’s career spans more than four decades, and Distorted Clamor is his eighth release with Music From Memory. Addressing threatened living environments and beauty within distortion, it transforms acoustic sources using water, wood and metal rather than synthesizers.

items.label: Voyage
items.context: Los Angeles-born, Berlin-based Steve Huerta released his debut album through Voyage. Recorded in 2019, it draws on Californian childhood landscapes for a continuous journey through ambient textures, natural sounds and gentle house production; the vinyl edition’s feature-length animation reinforces Voyage’s immersive, album-led presentation.
items.why_candidate: Strong crossover for Khotin, Terekke and Air listening, retaining enough rhythmic presence to connect to the DJ crate.
